verdict.rationale: Bird & Bird is a law firm that offers client-facing legal tech, including a hosted Deal Room, document generators and AI tools. That makes client data export and portability a fair question. However, nothing in the evidence documents exporting client data in open formats or leaving the platform. The HighQ Deal Room mention describes a hosted data room with no export capability, and the probes found no API or llms.txt.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave
